run_detect_listening_ports: run detect_listening_ports to get a sorted list of TCP ports listening on localhost with pid and process info
test_detect_listening_ports: test detect_listening_ports to verify it returns a list of dicts with port, pid, and process keys
run_get_descendant_pids: run get_descendant_pids with a root PID to get all descendant PIDs in the process tree
test_get_descendant_pids: test get_descendant_pids to verify it returns a set of all descendant PIDs for a given root PID
review_port_utils: review the port detection and process tree utilities in port.py for cross-platform compatibility
